reviews.x: I ordered these after trying to buy some in in a store, and realizing they're my longer carried in store. Received them today, and they're great! All six are awesome colors/patterns, and they went on well and look great! I'm very happy with this purchase!

I love these nail strips. It is random and for a STEEPLY discounted price so of course it's not going to have the MOST popular designs. However, if you have some imagination you can adjust them to your liking. They just make it so quick to apply. These are great for days when I don't have time to do my nails but don't want to leave them bare (and sensitive to breakage!). I'm on the second set and I covered them in gel. It's nice because I usually use topcoat to prolong the wear but then there is

reviews.t: Assortment of colors. Way cheaper to buy as a ...
reviews.x: Assortment of colors. Way cheaper to buy as a pack or individually.  I do get a couple days longer out of these than regular nail polish, so normally use on vacation or other times when I can't touch up my regular polish.  Tip: add a regular clear coat of polish on top to seal the edges and make it last longer. I also brush another clear coat over the ends after a few days to make it last longer.

I was really looking forward to trying out all the different designs. I really love the nail strips. So you can imagine the disappointment i had when I realized none of the strips would stick to my nails. The strips must have been older so they were put in a package deal to get rid of them. So beware of great "deals" on strips.

I got some ok patterns, not my favorite but not bad either. I expected to get the boxes rather than these packets. They contain less strips than the boxes and don’t come with the buffer and stick.  I put my first set on today, and the quality seems the same. All the strips are in one package, so I’m not sure if the unused ones will dry out. I put them in a ziplock back right away so time will tell.

Collection I got was okay. A few of them were the ones I really didn't like so I was kinda bummed. But what can I do?  Other than that, it's a great bargain; you'll get 6 of them for the price of 1 1/2 at drug stores.
I got 2 prints (3 boxes of a lace print and 3 boxes of a floral print) - details says 6 different prints.  Will be returning ASAP.

I did not get the six that were listed in the product information section. Instead they substituted 2 of the kits with kits that are very ugly and I would not wear. Very disappointed. Would not order this product again.

All the designs are old product, discontinued. Out of all of the designs I just didn't care for one. I got a glitter set... That set barely came off the plastic and I almost didn't get my nails done. The other set took some skill but looked nice. So far I've only worked with 2 of the designs.
Be careful removing the strips  or they might rip.  Remove  clear shield first .  I practiced with one set and did well with the second set.  Again for the price it's a no brainer.

I was hoping for at least one solid color, but there were none in the group.  They're a bit thin, you have to be very careful when removing them from the backing.  I didn't really like the designs but I was able to polish over them which was good because it make my color last longer. They're good for practice, once I get better I'll order some of the higher end strips.

reviews.t: Love these stickers and for the price you cannot beat ...
reviews.x: Love these stickers and for the price you cannot beat it. I went to a store and saw the same price for just ONE pack! I love the color selection they give me. Put a top coat over these stickers and it will last you weeks. Love love love these stickers. Definitely worth every single penny!

Out of all the colors I received, I did not like any of them. Tried a few but ended up with cheap looking nails. I'd much rather use good ol' nail polish. Plus this is on the expensive side so I was expecting something better.

reviews.t: Don't order more than one set
reviews.x: Now the thing is I love this product, in general, it is so much easier than painting and definitely better than Jamberry, but my review is not on them it is on the variety of the sets that arrived. I had ordered two sets of 6 hoping to get a variety of different designs... Nope! I received doubles of all of them, some were decent but a lot of them were out there patterns. They knew both orders were going to me because they had taped both orders together but in separate packages and they were EXA

reviews.t: I have always loved using this product
reviews.x: I have always loved using this product, and this is an awesome price!  They seem to last a while as long as you put on your own top coat!!  Don't forget that small step because it will help them last.. you can also just open one of the packages and use a couple for accent nails or on your toes!  My only complaint with this particular product is the fact that the variety could've been a little better, but you really cant complain because they are $11 in store for one package!

reviews.t: These are so cheap for a reason!
reviews.x: Anyone who gave more than one star has gotta be working for sally Hanson. These are complete crap, they don’t look anything like the picture on the box and I am giving five star for easy to remove because if you plan on simply washing your hands you will wash them off one of the ones I tried weren’t stuck and made of paper the other ones chipped within minutes total waste of time and money. I will stick to paying more at the store.

reviews.t: I love these nails but disappointed on these
reviews.x: A lot of them would not pull apart from the plastic for me to put on my nail.  They wouldn't stick, or wouldn't even come off the plastic that was attached to them or they would just rip in half when I did try to peal off the plastic.  I love these nails but disappointed on these.

reviews.t: Did not like colors or designs.
reviews.x: They work as advertised but the assortment of colors I received were horrible. And some were duplicates. I threw all but one away. The colors did not come near matching the pretty photo. I do love how easy they are to apply and that the manicure lasts a long time.

These are the best! I use them all the time. My nails peel and break easily and nail polish does not last on my nails longe me than a couple days. These last at least 2 weeks! Easy to apply and easy to remove! Lots of colors and designs.
I received 4 nail strips and 2 other items (nail art and nail stickers) I did not want or ordered.  The advertisement specifically says “Sally Hansen Salon effects real 6 piece nail strips.
The greatest solution to peeling or chipped nails.  As easy as polish and lasts 10 days or so.  I get more compliments on these than anything else I use.
I only received 3 nail polish strip kits and the other 3 were nail polish stickers. I got ripped off, buyers beware!
I wish the package would have been a little more casual and not so wild
didn't like that you cant pick out designs!

reviews.t: Some are stickers not polish strips.
reviews.x: For the discounted price, I didn't mind getting some animal prints or not so pretty prints, but I did not receive 6 different "polish" strips. I received 3 different polish strips (which is what I thought I was getting) and 3 fabric nail sticker packets. These are two completely different things.  The nail stickers should have been discontinued from Sally H. and probably are.  The instructions say to apply a top coat, but why would you apply a top coat on felt material which ruins it? claims.text: Many reviewers find these a great value, especially compared to store prices, and would buy again.
Several reviewers were disappointed that the designs received did not match the listed variety, with duplicates or substituted prints.
Reviewers commonly note the designs are hit-or-miss, with some receiving colors or patterns they did not like.
Applying a clear top coat is frequently recommended to seal edges and make the strips last longer.
Some reviewers report the strips are thin or difficult to remove from the backing and can rip.
